paragraphs.text: Chapter 7, Danger Money
Shauna and Vanessa were in the back of the car. Their hands were tied. They were very frightened
as they tried to listen to the conversation of the two men in front of them.
What are you going to do with your 10% of the money, Steve?
I'd like to go on an ice holiday. Somewhere odd. What about you?
Vanessa looked at the two men. She had to concentrate. She had to think of a plan.
And she needed to think quickly. But she could only think of one thing.
Colin O'Flahat is three-year-old son. While they were waiting for her
minder outside the hospital, these two men came up to them. They were smiling and seemed nice when
they asked for directions to King's Cross Station. But when Shauna was pointing the best way to them,
the two men pushed them both into their car. They wanted the briefcase.
Did you see that crash between the lorry and the car with the plainclothes police?
Laugh Steve. He saw the wave and Essa and Shauna looked at each other, suddenly realising the truth.
Did you think that was us? Laugh the driver. They thought that was us in that accident.
Ha ha ha ha. And they laughed even louder. Just then their telephone rang.
The driver answered the call. Yes boss. Okay. The old building in East London.
Of course we've got the money. We're not stupid and the two ladies. No. There were only two.
What do you mean there's another one? You'll have to go and get her.
Vanessa knew then what she had to do. Carefully she pulled her mobile phone from her coat pocket
and started to write a text message. You are in danger. Men taking us to building in East London.
Be careful. Man coming for you. Go to police. S and V. It seemed to take forever to write the short
message. She took out the piece of paper with Haminda's number on it and typed 354 781 2 3 0.
Now she only needed to press send and then Haminda could get help.
Hey. What are you doing? Give me that. Steve turned around and tried to grab the phone.
Vanessa tried to press send but he was pulling the phone out of her hand.
Leave her alone. Shouted Shauna pulling on his arm trying to free Vanessa.
The driver was looking at them and couldn't control the car anymore. Steve got out his gun
but Shauna pushed him and he dropped it. You stupid woman. He shouted as he looked desperately
around his feet for it. Just then a police siren sounded in the distance. Steve looked up and saw
that a police car was blocking the road in front of them. Its blue light was bright in the dark
evening. The driver pushed his foot down hard on the brake. Shauna realized with horror that they
were going straight for it. Too fast. The car began to move from side to side dangerously out of
control. Vanessa screamed. Shauna held her breath ready for the crash. She closed her eyes waiting.
Her body went quickly forwards and then back. But there was no crash. When she was sure that the
car wasn't moving anymore she slowly opened her eyes. The car was just a few centimeters from a
police car. Suddenly a lot of policemen were all around the car and Shauna could finally breathe.
Their nightmare was over.
